posts.name: geoff907
posts.cooked:
Hello!

I was wondering if there would be a chance that GTG would include form fillable PDF character sheets as part of the benefits to the kickstarter? ( including the option to paste an image into where is the character image would be)

 If not would they consider allowing us to use their PDF with the character sheet that comes out to create one and put it online for sharing for free?

In our group we have laminated the character sheets for the starter kit so they work with erasable markers as well, it makes a slick professional looking character sheet and allows us to reuse it over and over again.   Would be cool after people made their characters to be able to make a professional looking sheet for them as well!

 I appreciate GTG thinking about this! Keep being awesome!
